verdict.rationale: Vanta's first-party pages say it runs automated tests across integrations such as AWS, Okta and GitHub, and continuously monitors connected systems so customers stay compliant beyond the audit (docs-10, 45, 16, 49, 26, 40). Failing tests can be surfaced through the Tests API, the MCP server and real-time webhooks (docs-7, 3, 6, 4). However, the evidence is mostly marketing-level and never states how often tests run. Missing for 10: documented test cadence or latency showing failures surface within hours, in-depth docs on test execution and alerting, independent or hands-on corroboration of continuous monitoring.
